name: Mutant Cryptid
source: Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered), Mutant Cryptids (pg. 59), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=57
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered) is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, Perception, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1; HP by its starting level. Adds the rare trait and mutant abilities: all four, or two not counting Unusual Bane.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more. The rules also add 1 to the damage of its other offensive abilities (2 for ones it can use only a small number of times, such as a breath weapon): change those by hand. Explosive End: choose a damage type appropriate for it (flame, acid, toxic goop or something stranger). A unique mutant ability of your own (written in the form) can replace one of the three that make it stronger, or Unusual Bane if it's detrimental.

choices.label: Abilities
choices.note: All four, or just two not counting Unusual Bane.

choices.label: Bane
choices.placeholder: saffron, the sound of children's laughter, ...

abilities.name: Unusual Bane
abilities.description: {Name} has an unusual weakness to {opt:bane}. The first time each round it comes within 15 feet of its bane or interacts with its bane, it takes {=max(1, level)} mental damage and must attempt a DC {dc:hard} Will save. On a failure, it's stunned 1 (stunned 3 on a critical failure).

abilities.name: Explosive End
abilities.description: When {name} dies, it explodes into flame, acid, a pile of toxic goop, or something stranger still, dealing {=max(1, (level + 1) / 2)}d6 damage to each creature in a 10-foot emanation (DC {dc:standard} basic Reflex save).

abilities.name: Shifting Iridescence
abilities.description: Whenever {name} takes energy damage to which it isn't resistant or immune, after taking the damage normally, it gains resistance {steps|5|9=10|17=15} to that damage type. If it had a resistance to a different damage type from shifting iridescence, the new resistance replaces the old one.
